# Comprehensive Analysis Task for wiki.md

## Objective
Read `/root/r/wiki.md` completely and extract a structured report.

## Required Extractions

### 1. Session Information
- Session ID
- Creation and update dates
- Model used

### 2. All Commands and Requests
- Extract every bash/shell command mentioned
- Extract every user request
- Sort chronologically

### 3. z.ai Conversation Paths
- Search for any mention of "z.ai" or "zai"
- Extract full file paths

### 4. Files Mentioned
- List all files read or written
- Full paths

### 5. Tasks Executed
- List every agent launched
- Description of each task
- Execution status (success/failed)

## Output Format

Write results to `/sdcard/exploration-artifacts/big_pickle_analysis.json`:

```json
{
  "session_info": {
    "id": "...",
    "created": "...",
    "updated": "...",
    "model": "..."
  },
  "zai_paths": ["/root/r/_RESUME/F1/zai_share_conversation.txt", ...],
  "commands": [{"line": 123, "command": "grep ...", "purpose": "..."}, ...],
  "user_requests": [{"line": 456, "request": "...", "status": "executed/pending"}, ...],
  "files_mentioned": ["/root/r/NB2/...", ...],
  "agents_launched": [{"name": "...", "task": "...", "status": "..."}, ...],
  "statistics": {
    "total_lines": 4503,
    "commands_count": 0,
    "files_count": 0,
    "agents_count": 0
  }
}
```

## Constraints
- Do NOT write to any file except `/sdcard/exploration-artifacts/big_pickle_analysis.json`
- Do NOT execute any shell commands
- Read and analyze only
- Target time: under 10 minutes
